cloth: four separate quick rustles of a stiff cotton lab coat sleeve as arms are thrown up, close, dry, pauses between, no voice
steps_lab: slow footsteps of one person in soft leather shoes on a bare concrete basement floor, eight separate steps with short gaps, dry, no music, no voices
click: a single small plastic remote control button click, close
beep: a microwave oven button beep, one short electronic beep
flutter: a single dry leaf fluttering and tumbling down through still air, very soft papery flutter
puff: a small cartoon smoke puff, a soft poof with a little sputter
spring_sign: a spring-loaded sign popping up out of a hat on a metal spring: one bright springy boing and a little wobble, cartoon, no music
chalk: chalk drawing a big circle on a chalkboard, one continuous scrape
klaxon: a basement laboratory self-destruct alarm: a loud repeating electronic klaxon whoop, small concrete room, no voices, no music
slide: a small plastic remote control set down on a metal lab bench, then two remotes slid quickly across it, four short separate scrapes, close, no music
self_pop: a small electronic gadget blowing itself up in someone's hands: one sharp little bang, crackle and a sputter, close, no music
